Name: (CP) Tropical Curry Recipe Availability
Author: VegasOctober
Description:
[size=5][b]Description[/b][/size]
Tired of having to wait for years for Gus to show up at the Ginger Island resort to get the Tropical Curry recipe for perfection? This mod gives you a couple different alternatives to get that recipe instead! You can now buy the recipe from Gus at The Saloon, or from Pierre at the Luau Festival.

In both instances, the recipe unlock requires 10 hearts with the associated vendor (Gus or Pierre) and requires you to have already visited Ginger Island (though it does [i]not[/i] require you to have unlocked the Ginger Island resort). The price is the same 2000g as when Gus sells it at the resort. 


[size=5][b]Installation[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿
[*]Download and unzip this mod into the [font=Courier New]Mods[/font] folder
[*]Run the game using SMAPI
[/list]

[b][size=5]Configuration[/size]
[/b]There are 2 configuration options, to enable/disable the recipe showing up at each of the vendors (both enabled by default). You can modify these with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url].


[b][size=5]Compatibility
[/size][/b]This mod is compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6. It should also work with any other mods that either add additional vendor items or modify vendor sell prices.
